findings.evidence: `cargo test -p schlange-github --lib` passed JWT RS256 tests; `cargo test -p schlange-github-fake` passed installation-token caching and downscoping tests.
Fake-GitHub client tests passed pagination, ETags, retries, host confinement, redirects, ambiguous writes, combined statuses and rate-limit handling (20/20 client tests).
`cargo test -p schlange-github --lib` passed `http::tests::a_slow_client_does_not_stall_the_others`; bounded-queue rejection is at crates/schlange-github/src/http.rs:269.

The feature admits that a webhook accepted by a lease follower remains pending until worker restart; takeover/recovery does not replay it (.agents/skills/verify-schlange/features/github-integration.md:32; crates/schlange-github/src/service.rs:33).
`cargo test -p schlange-github-fake` passed `lost_webhooks_are_recovered_by_reconciliation`; the worker runs reconciliation at startup and periodically (crates/schlange-github/src/service.rs:14).
All three `e2e_check_identity` tests passed, but the feature explicitly records that the GitHub read is not an atomic snapshot (.agents/skills/verify-schlange/features/github-integration.md:34).

Watchdog unit, lease and shadow tests passed, but the feature states it detects only one stall class and lacks full W-01 conformance and sandbox evidence (.agents/skills/verify-schlange/features/github-integration.md:35).
`cargo test -p schlange-github-fake --test security` passed `a_constitution_path_beyond_the_file_list_cap_is_not_queued`.
Security tests passed forged-author and command/push race cases, including `a_push_with_a_forged_bot_author_cancels_a_waiting_command`.
The 11 end-to-end tests passed queue branch creation, draft PR creation, batching, bisection and cleanup; the CLI scenario `p1-arztagent-two-step.yaml` passed I0-I5.

All five merge methods pass fake-GitHub tests, but squash/merge/rebase still use a pre-write base read because GitHub's merge API has no expected-base parameter (crates/schlange-github/src/forge.rs:1641). A base push in that window can land an untested tree before post-write detection (.agents/skills/verify-schlange/features/github-integration.md:39).
All nine landing tests passed, including halt-label and base-push changes during failed/rate-limited merge attempts.
Landing and security tests passed transient 405/409 re-evaluation, permanent 422 dequeue, workflow-permission refusal and `mergeable: null` handling.
End-to-end tests passed lying 5xx cases for landing, draft creation and queue-branch merges without duplicate landing.
`reads_that_lag_behind_writes_change_nothing` passed; stale merged, branch and draft reads did not reverse completed writes.
`storms_of_404_and_5xx_never_dequeue` passed, as did client tests for bounded 404/5xx retries.
End-to-end runs created and completed `Schlange merge queue` checks; the ruleset-required-check test confirms Schlange's own check is excluded from its gate.
`rate_limits_are_waited_out_and_landing_still_happens`, client budget tests, and `a_rate_limited_write_is_handed_back_not_repeated` all passed.
crates/schlange-github/src/permissions.rs:25 defines six required permissions plus optional `workflows`; doctor comparison and token-downscoping tests passed.

Mergify's pinned guidance says only `exempt` works completely and `always` leaves parts blocked (.research/mergify/merge-queue_github-rulesets.md:61). Schlange doctor reports `always` only as WARN, allowing a green exit (crates/schlange-github/src/doctor.rs:277). The setup script correctly installs `exempt` (scripts/schlange-setup.sh:104).
All six service tests passed, including crash-mid-landing recovery, command deduplication, durable delivery IDs and last-valid configuration persistence.

`cargo run -q -p schlange -- config validate crates/schlange-config/tests/golden/arztagent.yml` passed, but `cargo test --workspace` failed because schema-valid `merge_queue.batch_pull_request` is rejected as unknown with exit 1 instead of unsupported exit 2 (`golden::experimental_merge_queue_options_are_not_silently_supported`). Also, the source documentation's per-repository product toggles (.research/mergify/integrations_github.md:9) have no Schlange equivalent.

summary: Core fake-GitHub flows are substantial and mostly green, but the feature remains non-conformant: webhook takeover can strand accepted deliveries, watchdog/check identity remain partial, landing lacks atomic expected-base protection, doctor accepts a known-inadequate ruleset mode, and configuration validation is red. `cargo fmt` and clippy passed; the required CLI validation and MQ-18 two-step scenario passed. The fixed stress test timed out once under the full package run and passed alone. Every named MQ ID has a test or scenario, though MQ-18 still lacks Schlange-on-real-GitHub workflow-trigger evidence. Clean-room scans found no shared 15-word prose against the pinned Markdown, schema, or OpenAPI corpus.
